name: python-decimal-to-binary
title: Decimal to Binary Conversion
blurb: convert between decimal and binary strings: dec_to_binary turns a nonnegative integer into its base-two digits, binary_to_decimal reads a binary string back into an integer, and the audit reports any pair that does not round-trip; oversized or malformed inputs are named, never converted.
default_description: A conversion walker whose binary string is the standard base-two representation on every small integer, whose decimal reading is the value on every well-formed binary string, and whose audit names every pair that fails to round-trip.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: decimal to binary is division by two, binary to decimal is powers of two
